entities.title: Student Visa Application
entities.summary: The Consular Service Portal provides a full digital solution to the application process for student visas in Germany. Applicants must submit required documents and may be informed about the next steps after the first screening process.
eligibility: proof of acceptance of late arrival at university
required_documents: proof of payment of tuition fees
application_process: register for an appointment on the Consular Services Portal
wait for the first screening process
important_notes: incomplete applications result in delayed processing
applicants can assist the process by submitting proof of acceptance or enrollment letters
mandatory_prerequisites: proof of payment of tuition fees
